content: अयन {%a.%} [अय्-ल्युट्] Going (at the end of <ab>comp.</ab>); यथेमा नद्यः स्यन्दमानाः समुद्रायणाः <ls>Praśna. Up.</ls> .²1 Going, moving, walking; as in रामायणम्. .²2 A walk, path, way, road; आयन्नापोऽयनमिच्छमानाः <ls>Rv. 3. 33. 7</ls>. अगस्त्यचिह्नादयनात् <ls>R. 16. 44</ls>. .²3 A place, site, abode, place of resort; <ls>Bṛ. Up. 2. 4. 11</ls>. ता यदस्यायनं पूर्वम् <ls>Ms. 1. 10</ls> (occurring in the derivation of the word नारायण). .²4 A way of entrance, an entrance (to an array of troops or व्यूह); अयनेषु च सर्वेषु यथाभागमवस्थिताः <ls>Bg. 1. 11</ls>. .²5 Rotation, circulation period; आङ्गिरसाम् अयनम्; इष्टि˚, पशु˚. .²6 A particular period in the year for the performance of particular sacrificial or other religious works; <ab>N.</ab> of certain sacrificial performances; as गवामयनम्. .²7 The sunʼs passage, north and south of the equator. .²8 (Hence) The period of this passage, half year, the time from one solstice to another; see उत्तरायण and दक्षिणायन; <ab>cf.</ab> also सायन and निरयण. .²9 the equinoctial and solstitial points; दक्षिणम् अयनम् winter solstice; उत्तरम् अयनम् summer solstice; .²10 Method, manner, way. .²11 A Śāstra, scripture or inspired writing. .²12 Final emancipation; नान्यः पन्था विद्यतेऽयनाय <ls>Śvet. Up.</ls> .²13 A commentary; treatise. .²14 The deities presiding over the {%ayanas%}.
